# Duck Donald Trump

> Political humor merch. Two T-shirts on the Comfort Colors 1717: a cartoon rubber duck with an orange combover and a stencil "*uck Donald Trump." Sold in Terracotta, Butter, and White, printed and shipped on demand by Printful. $5 from every shirt goes to Democracy Forward Foundation, a 501(c)(3) legal nonprofit.

## Pages

- [Home](https://duckdonaldtrump.com/): the shirt, why it exists, FAQ
- [Big Stencil tee, $32](https://duckdonaldtrump.printful.me/product/unisex-garment-dyed-heavyweight-t-shirt): large stencil front print
- [Front and Back tee, $38](https://duckdonaldtrump.printful.me/product/uck-donald-trump-tee-front-and-back): small chest duck, full stencil on the back
- [Store](https://duckdonaldtrump.printful.me/): checkout, sizes, and colors on Printful
